remarks: Now available, this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 5-bath Colonial offers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience, tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac yet minutes from shopping, dining, golf, and public transportation. The open-concept kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, white cabinetry, stone countertops, and a sleek tile backsplash, seamlessly flowing into a spacious living room with a wood-burning fireplace. Upstairs, three generous bedrooms each feature en suite baths and large closets, while multiple office options on every level make working from home effortless. The dramatic lower level showcases soaring 20-foot ceilings, a full bath, wet bar, bedroom, flexible office space, and direct access to a multi-level deck. Outside, enjoy a private backyard oasis designed for entertaining with a stone patio, custom wood-burning grill, and plenty of room to gather. With a versatile floor plan, stylish updates, and an unbeatable location, this home delivers comfort, functionality, and timeless appeal.
